May 13, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Capstone Investment Advisors Llc increased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) (NXPI) by 219.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capstone Investment Advisors Llc bought 61,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 90,100 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.55 million, up from 28,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capstone Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $34.06B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.28% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $99.01. About 2.11M shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
Federated Investors Inc increased its stake in Cintas Corp (CTAS) by 5667.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Federated Investors Inc bought 111,527 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.12% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 113,495 shares of the apparel company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.69 million, up from 1,968 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Federated Investors Inc who had been investing in Cintas Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $19.63 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.07% or $1.95 during the last trading session, reaching $183.91. About 285,761 shares traded. Cintas Corporation (NASDAQ:CTAS) has risen 35.54% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.99% the S&P500.
